title: Fordham prints three accounts of the battle called Tours or Poitiers
summary: Fordham presents three accounts of the 732 Frankish-Arab battle, not a single official report.
body: Fordham's page is titled three accounts of the encounter of Arabs and Franks in 732. The sourcebook places more than one telling on the page, including a reported opinion of the emir who conquered Spain. The card records that three accounts are presented. It does not pick a winner among them. The wording on the page includes: "Internet Medieval Sourcebook Arabs, Franks, and the Battle of Tours, 732: Three Accounts [Davis Introduction] The following opinion was expressed about the Franks by the emir who conquered Spain, and who---had he not been recalled---might have commanded at Tours. It shows what the Arab leaders thought of the men of the North up to the moment of". The evidence label is the truth-gate ceiling for this host. The host is not on the gate's primary-text or official list, so the label is weak. The quotation is still the page's wording.
